stations.title: Hesper
stations.note: And Sefton waits for all of them.

stations.title: Your runner
stations.text: One long list, sharing one job book.

captions: Hesper can't find anything in the long report, and Sefton waits for every test.
Today the job book tests share one book, so each finds the last one's jobs.
You add groups, setup and a way to run one test alone, in three tasks.
Now every job book test starts with a fresh book, under its group's name.
From a list of functions to a runner of its own, every line one Ashgrove can read.
